Title: Green Lake Park
Note: 2.8 miles around, flat, and always full of people. If you are missing the Charles on a Saturday, start here.

Title: Lake Union Park
Note: South end of Lake Union. The Cheshiahud Loop runs six miles around the whole lake from here.

Title: Gas Works Park
Note: The north shore, looking back at downtown across the water. Best skyline in the city and nobody argues.

Title: Alki Beach Park
Note: Two and a half miles of actual beach with the skyline across the bay. Feels like a different city.

Title: Golden Gardens Park
Note: Ballard. Sand, driftwood, legal beach fires, and the Olympics going pink at sunset.

Title: Seward Park
Note: A 300-acre peninsula in Lake Washington with a 2.4-mile loop and old-growth forest in the middle.

Title: Madison Park Beach
Note: Small, calm, residential. Swimming raft in summer and far fewer people than Green Lake.

Title: Warren G. Magnuson Park
Note: Former naval air station on Lake Washington. Big open sky, an off-leash beach for dogs.
